latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Crypto Alert Aggregator.
- Aggregates real-time crypto market data with Twitter sentiment signals.
- Supports real-time price and volume monitoring across multiple assets.
- Filters and prioritizes alerts based on volume, price, and sentiment thresholds.
- Allows output via webhooks for external notifications.
